topic.name: The Last Bargain
topic.description: Tagore's poem follows a man looking for work who is offered hire three times -- by a king with power, an old man with gold, a maiden with a smile -- and turns each down, until a child on the beach offers to hire him with nothing at all, and that is the bargain that finally makes him a free man.

concepts.name: Rabindranath Tagore, the poet
concepts.description: The poem is signed with its poet's name directly beneath the final line.
concepts.definition: The poem 'The Last Bargain' is written by Rabindranath Tagore.

concepts.name: The king's power, counted for naught
concepts.description: A king comes by in his chariot, sword in hand, and offers to hire the speaker with his power, but his power counted for naught and he goes away.
concepts.definition: Sword in hand the king came in his chariot and said he would hire him with his power, but his power counted for naught.
concepts.source_evidence: ord ंn hand the King Came iN his char

concepts.name: The old man's bag of gold
concepts.description: An old man comes out with a bag of gold and offers to hire the speaker with money, weighing his coins one by one, but the speaker turns away.
concepts.definition: An old man came out with his bag of gold and offered to hire him with money.
concepts.source_evidence: An ॰ld man Came Out With his bag of gold

concepts.name: The maiden's offer of a smile
concepts.description: In the evening a fair maid comes out and offers to hire the speaker with her smile, but her smile fades into tears and she goes back alone.
concepts.definition: The fair maid came out and said she would hire him with a smile.

concepts.name: A child playing with shells
concepts.description: On the beach a child is found sitting and playing with shells, and offers to hire the speaker with nothing at all.
concepts.definition: The child was sitting on the sand playing with shells, and offered to hire him with nothing.
concepts.source_evidence: A Child Sat playing With Shells

concepts.name: A bargain struck in a child's play
concepts.description: It is this last, empty-handed bargain, struck in a child's play, that finally makes the speaker a free man.
concepts.definition: From henceforward that bargain struck in a child's play made the speaker a free man.
